customManagers.description: Rust toolchain pin. Renovate has no built-in manager for rust-toolchain.toml, and rust-lang/rust carries pre-1.0 tags that sort ahead of the versions wanted, so its GitHub releases are the datasource.

packageRules.description: Scala Steward owns Scala dependencies. Renovate's sbt manager reads the same build definitions and would raise a competing pull request for every one of them.

The JDK in an ecosystem image tag is a deliberate platform pin, not a version to chase. `el10-jdk:21` selects JDK 21, so a bump to `:25` silently changes what a build compiles and tests against; the baseline is decided once for the ecosystem and moved by hand. Version updates are therefore disabled while digest updates stay enabled, so a digest-pinned reference still tracks image rebuilds. Both the bare and registry-qualified names are matched, since a workflow may write either.
